import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Configuration
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/en_train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/en_test_2.csv"
SUB_DIR = "./submission"
VALID_RATIO = 0.9
SEED = 42

os.makedirs(SUB_DIR, exist_ok=True)


def main():
    print("Loading datasets...")
    # Load only necessary columns to minimize memory footprint
    train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH, usecols=["before", "after"])
    test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH, usecols=["sentence_id", "token_id", "before"])

    # Create strict hold-out validation split (never seen by the model during training)
    print(
        f"Creating hold-out validation set ({VALID_RATIO} train / {1-VALID_RATIO} val)..."
    )
    train_df = train_df.sample(frac=1, random_state=SEED).reset_index(drop=True)
    split_idx = int(len(train_df) * VALID_RATIO)
    train_df_train = train_df.iloc[:split_idx]
    train_df_val = train_df.iloc[split_idx:]

    # Build frequency mapping: before -> most frequent after
    print("Building token normalization mapping...")
    # Compute mode of 'after' for each 'before' efficiently
    norm_lookup = (
        train_df_train.groupby("before")["after"]
        .apply(lambda x: x.value_counts().index[0])
        .to_dict()
    )

    # Validate on hold-out set using exact match accuracy
    print("Evaluating on hold-out set...")
    val_preds = train_df_val["before"].map(norm_lookup).fillna(train_df_val["before"])
    holdout_accuracy = (val_preds == train_df_val["after"]).mean()
    print(f"Hold-out Accuracy: {holdout_accuracy:.4f}")

    # Generate predictions for test set using the trained mapping
    print("Generating predictions on test set...")
    test_preds = test_df["before"].map(norm_lookup).fillna(test_df["before"])

    # Prepare submission DataFrame
    print("Formatting submission file...")
    test_df = test_df.copy()
    test_df["after"] = test_preds
    test_df["id"] = (
        test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test_df["token_id"].astype(str)
    )
    submission_df = test_df[["id", "after"]]

    # Save to designated path
    submission_path = os.path.join(SUB_DIR, "submission.csv")
    submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
    print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
